description:
Give the comment list more room.

Compact comment header is a new option under Hushfeed settings > Comments. It removes the comment count, sort and close buttons, plus the suggestion area and its empty space. Comments start at the top of the panel, while the reply box stays available. Use Back or swipe down to close it.

It's off by default and needs a restart. Headers that switch between different lists stay visible so those tabs remain reachable.

The S22 check recovered 214 pixels for comments in the tested layout. Turning the switch off restored the original header. Reopening, restart, Back, downward-swipe dismissal and focusing the comment box were checked without posting anything.

Validation: 1503 runtime tests and 255 patch tests passed, along with both Android lint checks. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. The release receipt records those application checks. They aren't a claim that every TikTok surface was tested on a phone.

Use TikTok 47.0.3 with Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Keep your existing Manager signing key when updating. This download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

The recent remote-source repair is included. Refresh the existing Hushfeed source if Manager still shows the old metadata error; don't clear its data or change its signing key.
